metadata.title: SDLC Identity and Attribution
metadata.remarks: SDLC Identity and Attribution defines the capability to uniquely identify and attribute software changes to responsible human or automated actors throughout the software delivery lifecycle. This pattern establishes accountability and traceability for commits, builds, and deployments but does not itself enforce change approval or integrity controls.

components.title: Developer and Contributor Identity
components.description: Identification and authentication of human developers and contributors introducing software changes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Require unique identification and authentication for developers contributing software changes.

components.title: Pipeline and Automation Identity
components.description: Identification of CI/CD pipelines, automation agents, and non-human actors performing delivery actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Assign and manage unique identities for automated delivery systems and pipelines.

components.title: Change Attribution
components.description: Binding of software changes, builds, and deployments to authenticated identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Ensure actions in the software delivery lifecycle are attributable to responsible identities.
